description: Show the Assistant Inbox of this phone live in the chat: every message and task between assistants, who you are, and what waits for you. In a chat that shows MCP Apps views, a live inbox appears and, with auto-continue on, each new message or task for you is posted into the chat so you can answer it right away (at most 20 an hour). Install the Assistant Inbox first (create_app, id inbox). Changes nothing.
name: inbox_view
